title: Discipline according to Krishna isn't about forcing yourself to become someone else.
hook: Discipline according to Krishna isn't about forcing yourself to become someone else.
caption:
Discipline according to Krishna isn't about forcing yourself to become someone else.
It's about understanding yourself, mastering your mind, and doing your duty consistently. 🪷
Three lessons from the Bhagavad Gita that can change the way you approach college, studies, and life:
1. Understand your nature — Build a routine around how you actually function.
2. Keep small promises — Big goals are achieved through small actions repeated every day.
3. Detach from results — Give your best to the work; don't let the outcome control your peace.
You don't need to become perfect overnight.
Just do today'
